name: chinese-copywriting-guidelines
description: Antigravity CLI (agy) plugin that applies sparanoid's Chinese Copywriting Guidelines — auto-spacing between CJK and Latin/numbers, full-width punctuation, correct proper-noun casing. 套用中文文案排版指北，讓 Antigravity 產出的中文文件符合中英數空格、全形標點、專有名詞大小寫等規範。
author: AndyAWD
